archive_coverage.note: A full back-series to 2016 was ALREADY published in the earliest capture, so the archive cannot show whether any given year page existed during that year.

budget: one working session, as fixed by amendment A10
method: Enumerate every Internet Archive capture of afdc.energy.gov/vehicle-registration.
Compare the values in the earliest and other captures against the live page today.
An unchanged value proves stability; it does not prove contemporaneity.
question: Are AFDC's year= registration pages contemporaneous annual snapshots, or retrospective reconstructions from later VIN data? Bears on D1: a page labelled 2020 is not proof the numbers were available in 2020.

resolution.consequence_for_phase_5: VALIDATION.md must state that the 2020 and 2021 rolling origins rest on a technical vintage LABEL whose information-availability semantics are unverified, while the 2022 origin is supported by an archived capture predating it. The D1 runtime check feature_vintage <= prediction_cutoff remains mandatory and is unaffected; what is unverified is the meaning of the label, not the mechanics of the guard.
resolution.established: Values for the 2020 and 2021 vintages are byte-identical between their archived captures and the live page today. The series is not retrospectively revised within the observable window.
resolution.not_established: Whether the 2020 and 2021 figures were PUBLISHED during or shortly after those years. No capture exists before 2022-08-18, so for the 2020 and 2021 rolling origins contemporaneity cannot be demonstrated from the archive. The 2022 origin falls inside the observable window.
resolution.publisher_statement: AFDC states only that counts 'reflect the total number of light-duty registered vehicles through the selected year' and are derived by NLR from Experian data. It makes no claim about when a given year's figures were produced.
